text.title: Ramp Task Difficulty Ladder Decision Tree

decision-tree.root-question: Does the team hire at least 3 developers a year, and is there at least one merged PR from a previous newcomer to anchor the rungs?

branch.question: Are rungs defined by observable scope, are duration bands non-decreasing with rung 1 under a day, and does buddy support fade up the ladder?

branch.when: any rung pattern uses story points, sizes or easy/medium/hard
branch.conclusion: Repair: rewrite the rung patterns as files / modules / feature flag / design review scope before tagging tickets.

branch.when: duration bands decrease up the ladder OR rung 1 upper bound > 1 working day
branch.conclusion: Repair: reorder or re-band the rungs; rung 1 must be mergeable within a day.

branch.when: buddy support is flat, non-monotonic, or reaches none inside the ramp window
branch.conclusion: Repair: full pairing at rung 1, check-ins only at the top rung, strictly decreasing between.

branch.when: rung 1 evidence is a sandbox or training-repo task, not a merged PR on the production repo
branch.conclusion: Repair: replace rung 1 with real merge-to-main changes that run the full pipeline.

branch.when: any rung's evidence is an unstarted backlog item, a senior engineer's PR, or TBD
branch.conclusion: Repair: link a merged PR from a previous newcomer with its actual duration, or mark the rung `not_applicable: unvalidated`.

branch.when: ladder shape valid AND fewer than 2 tickets per rung tagged before the start date
branch.conclusion: Block the start date: tag at least 2 tickets per rung, keep rungs 1 and 2 off the committed sprint scope.

branch.when: ladder shape valid AND tickets tagged AND a newcomer is mid-ramp
branch.question: Has the newcomer merged a ticket on the current rung, and is the current ticket inside twice its expected upper bound?

branch.when: current rung ticket not yet merged OR ticket past 2x expected upper bound
branch.conclusion: Hold the rung; if overrun, re-classify the ticket rather than grade the newcomer.

branch.when: current rung ticket merged inside its band
branch.conclusion: Promote to the next rung; record actual duration against the rung for the outcome review.

branch.when: ladder shape valid AND tickets tagged AND outcome review due
branch.conclusion: Run the review: record time_to_first_pr and rung reached per newcomer; re-band any rung whose median actual duration is outside its band; bump the version.
Skip the versioned ladder. Write a one-off onboarding doc; revisit once hiring reaches 3/year and one ramp has produced merged PRs to anchor the rungs.

example.p: Team hired 4 devs last year; rung 1 evidence is PR #812 (docs fix, merged in 3h by the previous hire); 2 tickets per rung tagged `ramp/rung-N` before start date → newcomer merges rung-1 ticket on day one → promoted to rung 2 → conclusion run-the-checklist.
